QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] The God of Battle
QuestInfo.0: Among many legends spoken in the Land of Warriors, is a tale of the #eGod of Battle#n. This amazing being is said to be #elarger than normal humans#n and able to shake the world with a single kick...\r\n\r\nMansa from the Land of Treasure is become enormous by eating treasure. Perhaps if you did the same you could convince someone you were the #eGod of Battle#n?

QuestInfo.2: Among many legends spoken in the Land of Warriors, is a tale of the #eGod of Battle#n. This amazing being is said to be #elarger than normal humans#n and able to shake the world with a single kick.\r\n\r\nOut of curiosity, you ate a #t2436086# to grow bigger. When you spoke with #p9400211#, they mistook you for the #eGod of Battle#n and offered you their treasure. You felt bad for tricking her, but thankfully you found a #t4036002# in her treasure!

0.msg: #h0#, have you heard the stories of the #eGod of Battle#n, by any chance?

1.msg: They are said to be bigger than ordinary humans. And according to the legends, one of their kicks has the power to shake the entire world and bring all the warriors to their knees!

2.msg: I really want to meet that god.

3.msg: #b(Mansa from the Land of Treasure is become enormous by eating treasure. Perhaps if you did the same you could convince someone you were the #eGod of Battle#n?)
